description: The calibration corpus for measure_voice (design section 3.2): the design text (the service's default design text, design section 16 and plan.md DC-13; the calibration set renders it first), three calibration paragraphs (150 to 300 spoken characters) and one ladder paragraph per rung of the length ladder (80, 150, 250, 300, 350, 400, 450, 500 and 560 spoken characters, each within 5 per cent). Narration prose in spoken form, with number words marked as exact spans and invented names.
design: docs/design.md revision 5.14, sections 3.2, 7.2, 11.3 and 16; plan.md DC-13
freeze: Frozen as version 1 on 2026-09-27, after gate H1 (plan.md section 5): the owner listened to sample renders and approved them. A frozen set never changes: the measurement key includes the corpus version (design section 10.2), so a changed text is a new set, narration-en.v2.
